genxml.title: Bridge-family registers and bits outside the census

struct.name: WID_ID_FORMAT
struct.from: shipped IRIX kernel binaries, per kudzu docs/ip35-pcibr-registers.md
struct.doc: The widget identification word as the shipped IRIX kernel reads it for the Bridge family. The kernel reads the 32-bit word at byte offset 4 of the widget window (WID_OFFSET), the low half of the slot that the census lists as wid_id at the slot address. It tells the layout apart by the part field.
